links.comparator_used: Prespecified (vendor/developer) decision threshold reused at the new site, versus locally calibrated and software-version-specific thresholds
links.outcome: Recall rate of AI algorithm (and cancer detection with calibrated thresholds)
links.effect: Recall rate 48.3% (21 929 of 45 444) with prespecified threshold vs 13.0% (5896 of 45 444) after threshold calibration; observed service level 5.0% (2774 of 55 916). Recall rates increased approximately threefold after a mammography software upgrade, requiring per-software version thresholds. With software-specific thresholds AI would have recalled 277 of 303 (91.4%) screen-detected cancers and 47 of 138 (34.1%) interval cancers.
links.tradeoff: Even after calibration, AI recall rate (13.0%) remained well above the observed service recall level (5.0%); thresholds need re-derivation after each software upgrade.
links.quote: The prespecified threshold resulted in high recall rates (48.3%, 21 929 of 45 444), which reduced to 13.0% (5896 of 45 444) following threshold calibration, closer to the observed service level (5.0%, 2774 of 55 916).
